status: Root-reviewed mathematical formula and10synthetic tests, passedparentcacheaudit binding corrected before first actualrun. Separate exact sourcefreeze required.
cohort: Five existing disjoint outer refits, each24 held-out original IDs, preserve the same96 training IDs and effective assigned Q1 products. Each profile retains120 original scenario rows; the five representative profiles are not independent customer samples.
unchanged_assignment: Compare every job/scenario/profile effective assignment and assigned flag with the existing own-horizon OOF record. A mismatch fails and preserves an attempt receipt. Use only that job's saved training fit and assigned product; do not select weights, gamma, a new product or different action. Review entries, including the existing A/D Review cases, retain all capacity financial fields NULL and generate no annual capacity rows.
annual_static_reference: For an assigned static product, the annual full-target restoration leaves post-fee holdings proportional to original weights w. At that year's end, shares_i=w_i*(1+r_i)/sum_j w_j*(1+r_j), independently of the common wealth/CPI scale. Evaluate only that profile's original H endpoints; B15/C30/E6 do not inherit each other's horizon. This is a Q1 static product-property reference, not Q2 autonomous execution admission.
bill_floor_drift: Report target bill share, annual end bill share, and end share<normative target floor-1e-12. A below-target-floor endpoint is a drift observation, not evidence that the original chosen target violated its floor or that a withdrawal liability defaulted.

hypothetical_liquidation.rule: At one annual endpoint, hypothetically transfer all nonbill assets into bills, using the same destination-buy fee convention. For holdings x, transferred=sum(nonbills)/(1+c), available_bills=x_bill+transferred, fee=c*transferred.
hypothetical_liquidation.funding: available_bills+fee=sum(x); this agrees with execute_target(x,e_bill,c). Fees are paid exactly once within this hypothetical conversion.
hypothetical_liquidation.reported_units: Pass endpoint shares, so available_bill_ratio and liquidation_drag are fractions of that endpoint's nominal wealth, with ratio+drag=1. No dollars of actual withdrawal are asserted.
hypothetical_liquidation.no_path_charge: This extra hypothetical conversion is never applied to the investment path, never deducted from its financial metrics, and is not an actual policy action or new strategy run.
hypothetical_liquidation.scope: Annual contest tradability only. No instantaneous/intrayear access, execution-delay estimate, bid-ask spread model, capital guarantee, client expenditure schedule or liability-funded liquidity claim. Bill real gross can be below1.

bill_real_loss_indicator: For the same assigned original-H years record bill_real_return=(1+nominal_bill_return)/(1+inflation)-1 and the fraction strictly below0. This is separate from bill share and hypothetical liquidation drag; it is not portfolio default or a cash guarantee test.

outputs.path_capacity.csv.gz: Exactly600 original scenario-profile metadata rows. Assigned entries have complete original-H ratio summaries; Review capacity fields stay NULL. Fixed declared header.
outputs.annual_capacity.csv.gz: One row for each assigned original-H endpoint, sum_assigned H. Review contributes0 rows. Fixed declared header survives an empty annual cohort.
outputs.summary.json: Five separate profile summaries, original_n120, financial_n and review_n, conditional assigned path statistics; all numeric capacity statistics NULL when financial_n0. No pooling profiles/horizons as IID.
outputs.manifest.json: Source/protocol/input snapshot, complete/failed phase and output hashes. No fit, policy run, actual withdrawal or extra investment-path liquidation fee.

engineering_gate: Before load_paths, require a separate source-freeze execution_ready record bound to this protocol and exact complete runtime/test/input hashes. Freeze must include original own-fit/partition and passed parent Q1 audit evidence. The raw loader requests only range(1,121),allow_final=False, with unrequested final return values never parsed. Existing output is refused; create the attempt before loading and retain failed receipt/traceback. Recheck frozen dependency hashes before completion.
historical_exposure: Previously reused development paths and static fits; no independent new validation or favorable result promise. This task does not read121-180 or change any old learner/final archive.
independent_result_check: After a first guarded run, a separate saved-output audit should verify identities/NULLs/ownH denominators and scalar formulas. This source-only method review and synthetic suite do not constitute such an audit.
